gancho: Pele reaches the Hawaiian Islands with her magic digging stick, the Paoa, looking for a home for her fire. On Kauaʻi and Oʻahu she digs pit after pit, at Salt Lake, Punchbowl and Diamond Head, but every time the sea rushes in. Based on N. B. Emerson, Pele and Hiiaka (1915), and W. D. Westervelt, Hawaiian Legends of Volcanoes (1916).
